name: Cajonera para audio
adaptations: Original in plywood as well; written in T18.
480 mm wide instead of 500: those 20 mm take it from two T18 sheets to one.
The slot pulls are drawn as finger notches.
Dividers inside each drawer for records are not drawn.
The drawer cells are given a back and the niche none: the niche shows the wall through it, the photos do not show behind the drawers.
anchored to the wall assumed: the photos do not show it, and the engine asks for it with drawers at this height
notes: Cajonera de triplay con un nicho abierto arriba para el equipo de audio y tres cajones con jaladera de ranura para cables, audífonos y accesorios, sobre patas cortas abiertas. Un disco de 12" no cabe parado en los cajones.
